nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Tomas and Grandmother gather bamboo and paper in the garden. The wind blows softly. They talk about the spring festival.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Grandmother tells Tomas about kites she made as a girl. Tomas listens closely. He is excited.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=55 beats='Tomas and Grandmother fly an old kite together. It is fun, but Tomas wants to build his own next year.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas says, "Let us make a kite!" Grandmother agrees. "What shape?" she asks.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They tie three bamboo sticks into a triangle. They glue red paper on. Tomas ties a long tail. The kite is ready.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They cross two sticks into a diamond. Yellow paper covers it. Grandmother adds a golden tail.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They shape bamboo into a bird frame. Blue paper and feathers make it look real. Tomas is proud.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They add red ribbons and stickers. The triangle kite looks bright and cheerful.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They add golden ribbons and sparkly stickers. The diamond kite shines.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They paint feathers on the bird kite. It becomes even more beautiful.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tomas runs. The triangle kite lifts but the wind shifts. It wobbles and spirals down into the grass.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Grandmother examines the kite. "Maybe we need a longer tail," she says.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The diamond kite soars high. Then a gust twists it. It flips and lands upside down. Grandmother examines it.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Grandmother says, "The wind is tricky. Let us make the kite stronger."'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The bird kite flies gracefully, but a sudden wind turns it backward. It lands on the roof.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Grandmother suggests a small tail. "It will keep it steady," she says.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Grandmother shortens the tail and ties extra ribbons. "This should steady it," she says.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They tie two more sticks across the frame. The triangle is now stronger. Tomas holds it up.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They tie colorful ribbons to the tail. The kite is now both strong and pretty.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They cut a small vent near the center. "Wind can pass through safely," Grandmother explains.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They add extra glue and a cross stick. The frame is now rigid and square.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They attach streamers to the diamond. It will look lovely in the sky.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They add a small tail and adjust the wings. The bird looks more aerodynamic.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They clip the wings narrower. It looks less like a bird but may cut the wind better.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They paint bright eyes on the bird kite. It looks alive.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The triangle kite flies better. It rises high. The wind changes again, but this time it recovers. Grandmother nods.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The diamond kite stays steady. It pulls strongly. Tomas holds the string firmly.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The bird kite climbs steadily. The wind swirls but it recovers. It flies almost perfectly.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='At the festival, Tomas flies the triangle kite. It soars high and steady. Everyone claps. Grandmother hugs Tomas. "We made a champion kite!"'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The diamond kite glides over the crowd. The wind is steady. It looks beautiful. Tomas feels proud.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The bird kite flaps its wings in the wind. It looks real. The festival guests cheer. Tomas and Grandmother smile.'>>
